scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays MirDB branding, tagline, value proposition, and call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Open the MirDB landing page in a browser
steps.context: Page should load successfully with hero section visible above the fold

steps.description: Check that the MirDB logo (logo.gif) is displayed correctly
steps.context: Logo should be visible and properly sized

steps.description: Confirm tagline 'A Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is present
steps.context: Tagline should be prominently displayed below or near the logo

steps.description: Check for 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons
steps.context: Both buttons should be visible and clickable

test_cases.expected: Hero section is visible with logo.gif image displayed

test_cases.input: Check hero section for tagline text
test_cases.expected: Text contains 'Persistent Key-Value Store' and 'Memcached Protocol'

test_cases.input: Locate CTA buttons in hero section
test_cases.expected: Two buttons present: 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub'
Link navigates to https://github.com/yetone/mirdb
Hero section mentions 'drop-in memcached replacement' capability

scenarios.name: Features Section Grid
scenarios.description: Verify the features section displays all four key features with proper descriptions and icons

steps.description: Scroll to or click on Features navigation link
steps.context: Features section should be accessible from navigation

steps.description: Check that all four feature cards are displayed
steps.context: Features: Memcached Compatible, Persistent Storage, High Performance, Configurable

steps.description: Each feature card should have descriptive text explaining the benefit
steps.context: Descriptions should match PRD requirements

test_cases.input: Count feature cards in features section
test_cases.expected: Exactly 4 feature cards are present
Feature card explains that existing memcached clients work without modification
Feature card mentions LSM-tree architecture and SSTable-based storage
Feature card mentions skip-list memtable and compaction strategies
Feature card mentions configuration options for deployment scenarios

test_cases.input: Verify feature cards have icons or visual indicators
test_cases.expected: Each feature card has an associated icon or visual element

steps.context: Use header, nav, main, section, footer appropriately

steps.description: Verify all images have appropriate alt attributes
steps.context: Alt text should describe image content

steps.description: Navigate entire page using only keyboard
steps.context: All interactive elements should be reachable via Tab

steps.description: Verify text has sufficient contrast against background
steps.context: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text

test_cases.expected: Skip to main content link is present for screen readers
Logo image has alt='MirDB logo' or similar descriptive text
Usage GIF has descriptive alt text explaining the demo
All interactive elements are reachable in logical order
Visible focus indicator on all focusable elements
Copy buttons have aria-label describing their function
Text meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio minimum
Headings follow proper h1 > h2 > h3 hierarchy
